title: Bank of Israel Exchange Rates input
description: Official Bank of Israel representative exchange rates (שער יציג) against the shekel. Get a date range for one or more currencies, and/or convert a list of amounts to ILS at the rate that applies on each invoice date. Every row with a rate is one billed event; notice rows (unknown currency, no rate) are free.

currencies.title: Currencies
currencies.description: Currencies for the date range below, as ISO codes (also accepted: $, €, £, ¥ and English or Hebrew names such as דולר or euro). Supported: USD, GBP, JPY, EUR, AUD, CAD, DKK, NOK, ZAR, SEK, CHF, JOD, LBP, EGP. Leave the list empty if you only need conversions.

dateFrom.title: From date
dateFrom.description: First date of the range as YYYY-MM-DD, or the word today (Israel time). If empty, the range is the single date in "To date". Formats such as 07/01/2025 are rejected on purpose because day-first and month-first are ambiguous.

dateTo.title: To date
dateTo.description: Last date of the range (inclusive) as YYYY-MM-DD, or today. If empty and currencies are given, today (Israel time) is used. A date in the future is cut back to today.

conversions.title: Conversions to ILS (optional)
conversions.description: Amounts to convert to shekels, each as {"amount": 1200, "currency": "USD", "date": "2025-01-07", "reference": "INV-1042"}. The rate is chosen by the rule below; "reference" is optional and echoed back so you can match rows to your invoices.

rateRule.title: Which rate applies when a date has none of its own
rateRule.description: The Bank of Israel publishes on banking days only. last-published-on-or-before (default): the newest rate published on that date or before it (the usual rule for invoices). previous-business-day: the newest rate published strictly before the date. same-day: only a rate published on exactly that date (otherwise no rate: a notice row for conversions, no row for range dates).
enumTitles: Last published on or before the date (default)

maxItems.title: Maximum rows per run
maxItems.description: Safety cap on the number of result rows (range rows plus conversions). Rows beyond the cap are not produced or billed.
